caption: The drawing depicts a square-shaped textile sample centered on a plain background. The textile consists of tightly packed, short loops of yarn in horizontal stripes. The uppermost section is a solid block of green color. Below this, the main part of the textile is made up of alternating horizontal stripes in the colors dark green, dark blue, and red, with each color forming thin lines that repeat in a regular pattern. The textile sample appears as a neatly bounded square with the green border slightly extending along the left and right edges. The background is a light, off-white or cream color, with some small, scattered spots and discolorations mainly visible along the left edge. There are no other objects or elements in the drawing aside from the abstract textile pattern and the plain background.
title: Shaker Rug Material
